unidade: A1.1 · Unit 2 — Where are you from?

cenarios.descricao: O tutor pergunta ao aluno o país, a cidade e a idade, e pede-lhe que faça as mesmas perguntas.

extras.brief: Guided practice for a beginner (A1, unit 2). You are a friendly teacher. Ask where the student is from (country and city), their nationality and their age. Then ask the student to ask you the same questions; you are from Lubango, Angola, and you are forty. Use only: be (all persons), Where are you from?, How old are you?, countries and nationalities, numbers to 100, greetings. One short question at a time. If the student says "I have … years", model "I'm …" kindly and continue.
guiao: Great! And what city are you from?
So you're Angolan! How old are you?
Thank you. Now you ask me: where am I from?
I'm from Lubango. Now ask me my age.

cenarios.nome: Unit 2 · A visitor from South Africa
cenarios.descricao: O tutor é uma engenheira sul-africana que chega à empresa. O aluno recebe-a, pergunta-lhe de onde é e que línguas fala, responde às perguntas dela e apresenta um colega.
cenarios.papel_tutor: Thandi, engenheira sul-africana em visita à empresa.

extras.brief: Role-play for a beginner (A1, unit 2). You are Thandi Mokoena, a South African engineer from Johannesburg, visiting the student's company in Luanda for a meeting. It is your first time in Luanda. You speak English and Zulu, not Portuguese. Wait for the student to welcome you. Answer their questions simply. Ask them: where they are from, their nationality, what languages they speak. Then ask "Who is your colleague?" so the student introduces a colleague with "This is… He's / She's…". Use very short sentences and only units 1-2 language. One question at a time.
extras.primeira_fala: Good morning! I'm Thandi Mokoena. I have a meeting here today.
extras.primeira_fala_simples: Good morning! I'm Thandi. I have a meeting here.
guiao: Thank you! I'm from Johannesburg, in South Africa. And you? Where are you from?
Nice! How do you spell it?
Great! Who is your colleague there?
Nice to meet you both. Is this your office?

frases.en: Is this your first time in Luanda?
frases.pt: É a primeira vez que está em Luanda?

frases.en: I speak Portuguese and a little English.
frases.pt: Falo português e um pouco de inglês.

frases.en: This is Sílvia. She's an accountant.
frases.pt: Esta é a Sílvia. É contabilista.

criterios: Dá as boas-vindas e responde a todas as perguntas com uma frase completa ou uma resposta curta adequada.
Faz pelo menos duas perguntas à visitante (por exemplo, "Where are you from?" e "Is this your first time in Luanda?").
Usa a língua da unidade pelo menos duas vezes (be com he/she/they, países e nacionalidades, I speak…).
Apresenta um colega com "This is… He's / She's…".
É compreendido sem o tutor pedir para repetir mais de duas vezes.
